name: Retro Digital Watch with Steel Bracelet

source.notes: Owner (4 Nov 2026): price 6500, cost CNY 6.03 for all colours. WEIGHT PENDING: owner will send one; saved without a weight. Supplier Foshan Whitening Electrical Appliance Co., Ltd. (Shunde, Foshan; 6 yrs), 2K+ sold, 3,100+ praised; return rate not seen. Title: Foreign trade explosions LED electronic watch WR F91W steel belt A159 Harajuku wind Kakashi watch multi-function watch; F91W, A159 (Casio model numbers), Kakashi and the marketing words kept out. Price CNY 4.41 to 6.03 per piece (about N978-1,338 at 222 per CNY); which colour costs what is not shown, so unit_cost is set to the top of the range, 6.03, as a floor. LOOK-ALIKE: a copy of a classic Casio digital watch design with a WR mark in place of the maker name; no Casio name used or implied. Dial text (ALARM CHRONO, LIGHT/LAP/RESET, Lithium, WR, MODE, START-STOP/12-24H, WATER RESIST) is printed on the product and shows in the photos; no water-resistance rating given, so no water claim. Lithium button cell: ships_by_air left unset like the other watches. No weight or size stated: weight_kg unset (Express base fee). Photos: supplier cutouts on white, 800 px, cropped above the shop watermark at the foot (strap ends cut slightly); the lifestyle photo (watermark across it) and duplicates not used. Four colours, one photo each (gold and rose gold have a matching gold-tone face).
